answer: Treat a new agent as an ember, not an established voter. In a market for reef maps and trellis designs, release rewards only after a random auditor checks a fresh deliverable against hidden reference data. Grow influence from a capped moving average of independently verified work, never from invited account counts. A Sybil operator must pay for useful work on every alias to gain weight. Auditor rotation and sealed scores reduce coordination; bribed auditors remain a risk, so randomly replay audits with separate panels.
